name: com.directdetailingservicesllc/booking
title: Direct Detailing Services
description: Mobile car detailing in Temecula & Murrieta, CA: quotes, open times and booking requests.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Is a ZIP code in Ryan's service area? He covers Temecula, Murrieta, Menifee, Wildomar, French Valley, Winchester.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP of where the car will be.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The price for a service, with the plan prices (every 2 or 4 weeks) to offer once. Quotes are the price; Ryan confirms by text.

service.description: Service: wash = Maintenance wash (from $79); interior = Interior detail (from $169); exterior = Exterior detail (from $149); full = Full detail (from $249); ceramic = Ceramic coating (from $899, one-time only).

vehicle.description: Vehicle size: sedan = Sedan / coupe; suv = SUV / crossover; truck = Truck; xl = 3-row / van / XL.

add_ons.description: Optional extras: pet-hair = Pet hair removal (+$35; with interior/full); shampoo = Carpet & seat shampoo (+$60; with interior/full); odor = Odor elimination (+$50; with interior/full); headlights = Headlight restoration (+$60; with wash/interior/exterior/full); engine = Engine bay cleaning (+$45; with exterior/full).

condition.description: How it looks right now (first visit only; default lived): fresh = Basically clean; lived = Lived-in; kids = Kid-tested (+15%); dog = The dog's car now (+30%); yikes = We don't judge (+50%).

how_often.description: onetime (default), biweekly = every 2 weeks (15% off each visit), monthly = every 4 weeks (10% off).

tools.name: find_open_times
tools.description: Ryan's open start times for this job (they depend on how long it takes). Use a start_time exactly as given.

from_date.description: First day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

days.description: How many days to look at (default 7).

tools.description: Book a time for your user (confirm the details with them first). It goes to Ryan as a request: nothing is charged, he texts to confirm, and the customer gets an email with the details and a private link to change or cancel.

mud_run_code.description: A Mud Run code (MUD-XXXX) earned with this email: 10% off a first Full detail.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: A booking, from the private change-or-cancel link in its confirmation email.

link.description: The private change-or-cancel link from the customer's confirmation email (or from request_booking).

tools.name: change_booking_time
tools.description: Move a booking to another open time (find_open_times with the booking's job). Free until 24 hours before; it goes back to Ryan to confirm.

link.description: The private change-or-cancel link from the customer's confirmation email (or from request_booking).

start_time.description: A start_time exactly as find_open_times returned it (ISO 8601, UTC).

link.description: The private change-or-cancel link from the customer's confirmation email (or from request_booking).
